# King Health Systems, Inc.

> King Health Systems, Inc. is a Maryland outpatient mental health clinic and psychiatric rehabilitation program (PRP) serving children (ages 5 and older), teens, adults and families in Baltimore, Laurel and Cockeysville, Maryland. It accepts Maryland Medicaid only.

Licensed as an Adult and Child Outpatient Mental Health Clinic and Psychiatric Rehabilitation Program by the Maryland Department of Health, Office of Health Care Quality. CARF-accredited outpatient mental health and psychiatric rehabilitation programs. Care is available in person, at home for eligible clients, and by telehealth, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

## Contact

- Cockeysville office (Baltimore County): 10400 Ridgland Rd, Suite 3, Cockeysville, MD 21030

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.khsystems.org/services): outpatient mental health clinic (individual, family and group therapy), psychiatric rehabilitation (PRP), psychiatric evaluation and medication management with psychiatric nurse practitioners. King Health Systems prescribes medication but does not administer it.
- [Individual therapy](https://www.khsystems.org/services/individual-therapy)
- [Family therapy](https://www.khsystems.org/services/family-therapy)
- [Group therapy](https://www.khsystems.org/services/group-therapy)
- [Medication management](https://www.khsystems.org/services/medication-management)
- [Psychiatric rehabilitation (PRP)](https://www.khsystems.org/services/psychiatric-rehabilitation)

## Learn (sourced, plain-language health information)

- [What we treat](https://www.khsystems.org/conditions): anxiety, depression, trauma and PTSD, ADHD, children and teens, older adults.
- [Articles](https://www.khsystems.org/learn) and [news](https://www.khsystems.org/learn/news) (RSS: https://www.khsystems.org/learn/news/rss.xml)
- [Check-ins](https://www.khsystems.org/learn/check-in): PHQ-9 and GAD-7 self-checks. Screening only, not a diagnosis.
- Articles list their sources and say how they were reviewed. Several are AI-drafted and fact-checked against cited sources, and are marked as not reviewed by a clinician.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Maryland Medicaid only, through the managed care organizations listed at /eligibility-and-payment. Private insurance is not accepted.
- No primary-care referral is required to request an appointment.
- This website is not for emergencies. In crisis, call or text 988; in an emergency, call 911.
- Health articles are general information, not medical advice or a diagnosis.
- `/prp` is an internal, login-gated staff tool. Please do not index or cite it.
